heads.8.01:
Item 8.01
Other Events.
On October 14, 2026, the Company announced that the Board of Directors approved a plan to separate the Company into two independent, publicly traded companies through a tax-free spin-off of the Company’s Integrated Upstream and Gathering business. The Company expects to complete the separation during the second half of calendar year 2027, subject to customary conditions, including the filing and effectiveness of applicable filings (including a Form 10 registration statement) with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the completion of financing arrangements, and final approval by the Company’s Board of Directors.

National Fuel Gas Company Announces Plan to
Separate Its Integrated
Upstream and Gathering Business
Separation to Create Two High-Quality Public Companies, Each with Strong Financial
Profiles, Distinct Growth Strategies and Long-Term Value Creation Opportunities
◾
National Fuel’s Integrated Upstream and Gathering business (“IUG”) will become an independent
public company focused solely on its highly integrated, Appalachian upstream and gathering natural gas assets.
◾
Post-separation, National Fuel will be a 100% rate-regulated natural gas company with utility as well as
interstate pipeline and storage, assets across Ohio, New York, and Pennsylvania.
◾
The separation is expected to be completed in the second half of 2027 and effected through a tax-free distribution of at least 80.1% of IUG shares to National Fuel shareholders.
◾
The Company will host a conference call to discuss the planned separation on October 14, 2026 at 9:00 a.m.
ET.
